results.explanation: The color-coded legend suggests that stadium capacities are represented by colors (red for >70K, orange for 50-70K, yellow for 30-50K, etc.), but the colors on the map do not consistently match the labeled capacity values. For example, Camp Nou (99.3K) and Stade de France (81.3K) are both shown in different colors despite being in the same >70K category, and some stadiums with similar capacities are shown in different color categories.

The y-axis does not start at zero, which visually exaggerates the differences between the foreclosure values across years. This makes the growth from 0.4 million in 1999 to 0.9 million in 2006 appear more dramatic than it actually is, and similarly distorts the visualization of the projected 6.4 million foreclosures.

This chart displays metrics with vastly different scales and units (percentages, counts, grade levels, and readability scores) on a single horizontal bar chart, making meaningful visual comparison impossible. The top shows 0-100% while the bottom uses 0-160, mixing incompatible measurements that cannot be fairly compared visually on the same axis.
